description: Create product specification documents for missing features identified during analysis
steps: Create docs/specs/features/README.md with feature prioritization matrix
Create docs/specs/features/FEAT-CONFIG-WIZARD.md - Interactive Configuration Wizard spec
Create docs/specs/features/FEAT-CONTEXT-THRESHOLD.md - Context Window Budget Alerts spec
Create docs/specs/features/FEAT-SNAPSHOT-DIFF.md - Context Snapshot & Diff spec
Create docs/specs/features/FEAT-TEAM-PROFILES.md - Team Configuration Profiles spec
Each spec should include: Problem Statement, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Technical Design, MVP Definition, Success Metrics, Roadmap
acceptance_criteria: docs/specs/features/ directory contains README.md and 6 feature spec files
Each spec follows PM-focused format with user value prioritization
Specs include MVP definition and success metrics
verification: List docs/specs/features/ and verify all files exist
Read each spec to verify format compliance
